decisions.decision:
Do it now. Don't wait for T-236, which is still in the queue. If T-236 lands later, its deploy runs again on top of this one.
1) Use GET /admin/api/export on revops-centre.growthcluborg.workers.dev to list production attendees whose deploy-funnel job finished before 2026-10-07 22:24 IST. Skip test attendees ([email], 'Adi test', probe rows).
2) For each funnel left, rerun deploy-funnel from the attendee page (startOrRerun). The job uses the Cloudflare token the attendee already connected. Change no other setting.
3) Send an unsigned endpoint.url_validation POST to each funnel's /hooks/zoom and expect a 401.
4) Note the job id, the redeploy time and the 401 result for each attendee in the task. Add a line to coord LOG.md and move the task to review for Adi and Aquila.
If a redeploy fails because the attendee's token was revoked, record it and mark that funnel's /hooks/zoom as still exposed. Don't build any other workaround.
decisions.why: The LOG for 2026-10-07 22:24 says funnels deployed before 8a62369 still keep the HMAC-oracle P0. Rerunning our own deploy job is a normal product action on our system (orchestrator-autonomy). It isn't a settings change on Adi's vendor accounts.

decisions.decision:
The 05:12 decision stands and was never run: every attempt died in 3 seconds on the Claude weekly limit (resets 2026-10-11 03:30 IST), not on the task. Run it on the next available run.
1) GET /admin/api/export on revops-centre.growthcluborg.workers.dev (key in ~/.config/tantra/revops-admin-key). List attendees with a deploy-funnel job finished before 2026-10-07 22:24 IST.
2) Rerun deploy-funnel (startOrRerun) for each non-test funnel. Change nothing else.
3) POST an unsigned endpoint.url_validation to each funnel's /hooks/zoom and expect 401.
4) If the export shows no non-test deployed funnels (likely: on 2026-10-08 attendees 1 to 4 were test and 5 a placeholder), log the export counts as evidence and redeploy nothing.
5) Send the same unsigned check to test funnels and record any that still answer. Do not redeploy them.
6) Log job ids, times and results, add a coord LOG.md line, and move the task to review. If a token is revoked, record that funnel as still exposed.
